lines: The things I love about you
The weird quirks you have
Expressionless, yet somehow sharp
The corners of your mouth turning upward
I’ll give you a passing grade; you’re doing well
Who are you, the one who praises me?
What are you looking at
The two of us swaying, fluttering
Still, still, still, still, the subtle distance
The trembling feelings, swaying
My fingertips barely touch you
Shaking, touching, overflowing, overlapping
August night, I love you
Leaving the ice cream we bought on the way home
Again, the next one
I was somehow making it
Getting a little drunk, drifting gently
Thawing the frozen memories
Again to you
I’ve been searching for a reason we can meet
The things I love about you
The way you laugh like a child
A melody that makes me cherish you, softly
The sound that wraps around us
A night we groped forward like navigating a maze
The feel of summer, your feel
Before this summer ends
The two of us swaying, fluttering
Still, still, still, still, the awkwardness too
The trembling feelings, swaying
My fingertips barely touch you
Shaking, touching, overflowing, overlapping
August night, I love you
Tangled, going in circles, taking a detour
Again, love again
I was somehow holding it back
Getting a little drunk, drifting gently
Thawing the frozen feelings
Again to you
I’ve been searching for a reason we can meet
Is it just my imagination, or the summer’s fault?
I want to shrink the rising body temperature by a millimeter
The world with you
The two of us swaying, fluttering
Still, still, still, still, the subtle distance
The trembling feelings, swaying
My lips barely reach you
Shaking, touching, overflowing, overlapping
August night, I love you
Leaving the ice cream we bought on the way home
Again, the next one
I was somehow making it
Getting a little drunk, drifting gently
Thawing the frozen love
Again to you
I finally found a reason we can meet
The two of us on an August night
Shaking, touching, overflowing, overlapping
